ideas.pitch: A transparent supply chain tracking system for organic agricultural produce using cryptographic proofs to prevent certification fraud without exposing proprietary farmer supplier lists.
ideas.title: AgriTrace ZK: Verifiable Organic Supply Chain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive economic problem in AgriTech by bringing verifiable trust to organic labels, combining practical backend architecture with a compelling real-world use case that stands out from typical CRUD farm dashboards.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered defense suite that intercepts and analyzes real-time SMS streams and audio calls for localized linguistic scam patterns and social engineering tactics.
ideas.title: PhishGuard AI: Multi-Modal Scam Call & SMS Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly upon proven anti-scam mechanics with an aggressive focus on high-accuracy local threat classification, directly hitting the Cyber Security track criteria.

ideas.pitch: A secure health data sharing and audit logging platform utilizing multi-party computation and graph intelligence to track unauthorized access attempts across distributed hospital networks.
ideas.title: MediGraph AML: Patient Data Privacy & Access Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles the difficult intersection of strict healthcare data compliance and advanced risk-detection graphs, providing heavy technical depth that judges prioritize.

ideas.pitch: An interactive EdTech platform that converts complex data structures and algorithms assignments into multi-player gamified challenges equipped with an AI hint-generator.
ideas.title: EduQuest: Gamified Coding Mechanics with Latent Space Hints
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high student engagement via gamification with sophisticated mechanistic interpretation of student code submissions to diagnose exact logical misconceptions.

ideas.pitch: An advanced graph intelligence platform that aggregates decentralized weather, soil, and market pricing data to forecast localized crop failure risks and supply chain bottlenecks.
ideas.title: AgriYield Graph: Supply Risk & Market Intelligence Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replaces basic weather-app wrappers with sophisticated graph analysis and risk scoring, impressing judges with predictive analytics instead of passive dashboards.
